label: preparing
what: A civic presentation of thanks to the mayor from hospitality and local tradespeople, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00–18:30 in the great hall. Evidence suggests the innkeeper is organizing it, with baker, builder, freight, and neighbour among the tradespeople involved. The separate bridge/port-change talk remains unsubstantiated; the 44-loaf private order is confirmed but its purpose was withheld. The secretary knowingly coordinated the appointment and recorded it, but is administrative rather than clearly an event organizer.
